purpose: Teach: 差益/守秘/ターボ/コストダウン/返上/行革/株券/引渡し

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 為替差益の活用方法を経営陣に提案しましょう
lines.en: Let's propose to management how we can use these foreign exchange gains.
lines.style: Crisp, purposeful opening. Speaking as a colleague proposing a collaborative step forward. Even pace, confident but not commanding. Matter-of-fact delivery.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。守秘契約の更新を進めております
lines.en: Yes. We're moving forward with the confidentiality agreement renewal.
lines.style: Steady affirmation. Brief pause after the dash, then factual update delivered without fanfare. Professional but warm—acknowledging the plan is in motion.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 新プロジェクトをターボのように進めましょう
lines.en: Let's push the new project forward with real momentum.
lines.style: Forward-leaning directorial tone. Light emphasis on the urgency without pressure. Clear, measured pace. The voice of someone pointing the way.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。コストダウン目標を全社で共有しました
lines.en: Yes. We've shared the cost-reduction targets across the whole company.
lines.style: Confirmed update. Steady delivery of completed work. Brief pause after the dash. Professional acknowledgment that the step is done—no drama, just progress.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 業界協会の役職を返上する方針を伝えましょう
lines.en: Let's communicate the plan to step down from our industry association position.
lines.style: Clear directorial intent. Measured, deliberate pace. Slight weight on the decision being intentional, not rushed. The voice of someone making a careful choice.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。行革に向けた組織改編を準備しております
lines.en: Yes. We've confirmed the handover location for the customers.
lines.style: Final affirmation. Steady, concluding tone. Brief pause after the dash. Delivered as a checkpoint reached—detail confirmed, one more box checked.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 株券を電子化する手続きを進めましょう
lines.en: Let's move ahead with digitizing the share certificates.
lines.style: Directive with forward momentum. Even, purposeful pace. Speaking as someone guiding the next operational step. No hesitation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お客様への引渡し場所を確認しました
lines.en: Yes. We've confirmed the delivery location with the customers.
lines.style: Closing affirmation. Steady, warm finish. Brief pause after the dash. The tone of someone bringing a thread to completion—professional, satisfied.
